title: MingCute Screenshot Quality Recovery batch 013
review_goal: Differentiate five MingCute globe and book variants with screenshot grounded depicts and deterministic evidence fields.

items.depicts_observation: Globe outline with vertical longitude lines and horizontal latitude lines
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants the most complete globe grid with both meridians and latitude bands.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the simpler globe variants when the fuller grid pattern should stay visible.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot shows the densest globe grid with multiple curved vertical and horizontal bands.

items.depicts_observation: Globe outline with two curved side lines and one horizontal equator line
items.context_bias: Use when the interface needs a simpler globe with one equator and two side meridians.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the fuller globe grid when the cleaner three band structure matters.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot reduces the globe to one equator band with broad curved side meridians.

items.depicts_observation: Globe outline with a top cap panel side lines and one equator line
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a globe whose top arc is split into a visible cap section.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the standard globe when the top cap cut should remain visible.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot adds a small top cap panel above the equator and side meridians.

items.depicts_observation: Globe outline with two tall inner lobes and one horizontal equator line
items.context_bias: Use when the interface needs the most minimal globe made from two tall inner lobes and an equator.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the fuller grid globes when only two inner vertical lobes are shown.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot strips the globe down to two tall inner ovals plus one central horizontal band.

items.depicts_observation: Open book outline with softly curved bottom edges and two facing page panels
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants an open book whose bottom edges curve downward more softly than the flat book icon.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the straighter open book when the wavy lower page edges matter visually.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot differs from book by using softer curved lower page edges on the open spread.
